reason: A is better because it tests bulk plastic strain and fracture toughness against microstructure-matched pure tungsten at genuinely high, service-relevant temperatures and couples those outcomes to direct dislocation observations; B relies on 500–600 K nanoindentation creep, which cannot decisively establish bulk toughness under high-temperature plasma-facing service. A’s claim that lattice distortion lowers glide barriers is not well supported—and solid-solution disorder can instead impede dislocations—but its experiment can directly falsify that mechanism.
